thread:
Maya: Quick async standup — pipeline + enterprise sec asks. Will list current deals and blockers. Ping me for follow-ups.

Liam: NovaHealth update — Legal signed NDA. They're asking for SOC2 report and HSM-backed KMS. Shared redacted SOC2 already. Blocker: they explicitly asked for tenant-isolated HSM. @Priya any red flags? :thinking_face:

Priya: We can map options. Need to clarify: do they require on-prem HSM or cloud HSM with customer-managed keys (CMK)? If they insist on FIPS-certified, we need exact requirement text. On-prem HSM can only be supported via Private/on-prem discussions.

Liam: Quote from their security team: "FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM for key material storage, isolated per-tenant." I pasted the snippet in the CRM. If that's non-negotiable, we'll need dedicated + hardware HSM plan. @Maya

Maya: Dedicated capacity is our recommended route for isolation; for HSM we escalate to Private/on-prem or partner HSM solution. I'll prep a note for sales collateral. Next: CortexA.

Zara: CortexA POC went well. They want throughput guarantees and enterprise SSO (SAML). Blocker: they asked for per-route latency SLA p95=10ms. Also require EU-only data residency and retention <=90 days. @Alex can we hit 10ms?

Alex: 10ms p95 looks optimistic for long prompts. For short seqs we can approach that on Dedicated with reserved GPUs in-region. SAML SSO is supported. I'll validate latency charters with eng-runtime and confirm if we can offer conditional SLA (e.g., for sequences <256 tokens).

Priya: For CortexA I'll draft contract language for EU-only logs and 90-day retention. Also confirm whether CortexA wants logs ingested into their SIEM — that's doable via webhooks/syslog.

Liam: MacroHealth follow-up: they want Private (VPC) + audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. I told them this is supported. They also want the option to bring their own KMS. @sec-bot can you confirm log forwarding formats and size limits?

sec-bot: Automated reply — log forwarding supports syslog over TLS and HTTPS webhooks, max event size 64KB. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/log-forwarding (reacted :white_check_mark:)

Maya: Today I'll prepare a deal-mapping one-pager for each account (options: Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with quick bullets on KMS, SSO, retention, and estimated pricing delta. Blockers right now: NovaHealth HSM ask and CortexA latency SLA. Anything else folks?

Zara: :eyes: I'll flag both deals in the CRM with blocker tags and schedule CortexA follow-up for Wed. Also will attach Dedicated price comps.

Alex: Spun up a ticket with eng-runtime for an official latency quote. If they need 10ms p95 at 2k rps that's a perf eval — will update by EOD.

Liam: One more — MacroHealth wants us to fill their 30-question vendor security questionnaire. @Priya do we have a prefilled pack?

Priya: Yes — we have a vendor questionnaire template with prefilled SOC2/KMS/SSO answers. I'll attach and tailor entries for HSM and Private deployment notes.

Maya: Great — thanks everyone. If anything urgent tag @maya. Otherwise we'll reconvene tomorrow. :thumbsup:
